{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# NOTE: The PBS script is a template with placeholders like {{:ncpus}}, {{:mem}}, {{:wallhr}}, etc.
# Flux cannot resolve these without concrete values. This script keeps them as environment variables.

# Required inputs (set before running):
#   NAME DIR_NAME NCPUS MEM_GB WALLHR WRITE_DIR TYPE BMARK_TYPE
#   NX_PARTITION NY_PARTITION NZ_PARTITION N_EL_SIZE FE_ORDER VERBOSE NREPS

NAME=${NAME:-"{{:name}}"}
DIR_NAME=${DIR_NAME:-"{{:dir_name}}"}
NCPUS=${NCPUS:-"{{:ncpus}}"}
MEM_GB=${MEM_GB:-"{{:mem}}"}
WALLHR=${WALLHR:-"{{:wallhr}}"}
WRITE_DIR=${WRITE_DIR:-"{{{:write_dir}}}"}
TYPE=${TYPE:-"{{:type}}"}
BMARK_TYPE=${BMARK_TYPE:-"{{:bmark_type}}"}
NX_PARTITION=${NX_PARTITION:-"{{:Nx_partition}}"}
NY_PARTITION=${NY_PARTITION:-"{{:Ny_partition}}"}
NZ_PARTITION=${NZ_PARTITION:-"{{:Nz_partition}}"}
N_EL_SIZE=${N_EL_SIZE:-"{{:n_el_size}}"}
FE_ORDER=${FE_ORDER:-"{{:fe_order}}"}
VERBOSE=${VERBOSE:-"{{:verbose}}"}
NREPS=${NREPS:-"{{:nreps}}"}

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l ncpus={{:ncpus}}           -> -n {{:ncpus}} (best-effort: one rank per CPU)
#   -l walltime={{:wallhr}}:00:00 -> -t {{:wallhr}}h

# NOTE: PBS -P np01 and -q normal not translated.
# Performance implication: accounting/queue placement may differ; site may require project/queue out-of-band.

# NOTE: PBS -l mem={{:mem}}GB not translated.
# Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed.

# NOTE: PBS -j oe not translated.
# Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured.

# Build batch options using provided variables if they look concrete
BATCH_OPTS="-N 1 -n ${NCPUS}"
if [ "${WALLHR}" != "{{:wallhr}}" ] && [ -n "${WALLHR}" ]; then
  BATCH_OPTS="${BATCH_OPTS} -t ${WALLHR}h"
fi

JOBID=$(flux batch ${BATCH_OPTS} --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")
echo "Submitted Flux job: ${JOBID}"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  source "$HOME/hpc-environments/gadi/load-intel.sh"
  PROJECT_DIR="$SCRATCH/${DIR_NAME}/"

  # Prefer Flux for rank launch
  flux run -n ${NCPUS} julia --project="$PROJECT_DIR" --check-bounds no -O3 \
    "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/Benchmarks/benchmark_gadi.jl" \
    "$NAME" \
    "$WRITE_DIR" \
    "$TYPE" \
    "$BMARK_TYPE" \
    "$NX_PARTITION" \
    "$NY_PARTITION" \
    "$NZ_PARTITION" \
    "$N_EL_SIZE" \
    "$FE_ORDER" \
    "$VERBOSE" \
    "$NREPS"
fi
"
}
